templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 平方单位换算（毫米↔厘米）

stem.en: If {k} millimetres equal 1 centimetre, how many square centimetres does 1 square millimetre equal?
stem.zh: 如果 {k} 毫米 = 1 厘米，那么 1 平方毫米等于多少平方厘米？

solution.en: 1 cm = {k} mm, so 1 cm² = {k*k} mm². Then 1 mm² = 1 ÷ {k*k} = {dec} cm².
solution.zh: 1 厘米 = {k} 毫米，所以 1 平方厘米 = {k*k} 平方毫米；反过来 1 平方毫米 = 1 ÷ {k*k} = {dec} 平方厘米。

hint.en: Area units scale by the square of the length unit.
hint.zh: 面积单位的进率是长度进率的平方。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三人分钱后相等，求原有钱数

stem.en: If John gives Allen {a} dollars and Allen gives Frank {b} dollars, the three boys will have the same amount of money. How much more money does John have than Allen?
stem.zh: 如果 John 给 Allen {a} 元、Allen 给 Frank {b} 元之后，三个人的钱就一样多了。John 比 Allen 多多少元？

solution.en: Whatever Frank had, in the end he has his original amount + {b}. Allen ends with his original + {a} − {b}, and John ends with {a} less. Working through it, John − Allen = 2×{a} − {b} = {diff}.
solution.zh: 不管 Frank 原来有多少，最后他比原来多 {b} 元。Allen 最后比原来多 {a} − {b} 元，John 最后比原来少 {a} 元。相减得 John − Allen = 2×{a} − {b} = {diff}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由各位上的数写出小数

stem.en: What is the numeral value of {T} tens, {O} ones, {t} tenths, {h} hundredths and {th} thousandths?
stem.zh: {T} 个十、{O} 个一、{t} 个十分之一、{h} 个百分之一、{th} 个千分之一组成的数是多少？

solution.en: Work out the whole-number part first: {T} tens = {T*10}, plus {O} ones → {T*10+O}. The fraction part reads off the digits in order: {t} tenths, {h} hundredths, {th} thousandths, giving .{t}{h}{th}. So the number is {val}.
solution.zh: 先算整数部分：{T} 个十 = {T*10}，再加 {O} 个一得 {T*10+O}。小数部分按顺序读：{t} 个十分之一、{h} 个百分之一、{th} 个千分之一，即 .{t}{h}{th}。所以这个数是 {val}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 连续偶数之和（已知平均数）

stem.en: What is the sum of the {n} consecutive even numbers whose average is {avg}?
stem.zh: {n} 个连续偶数的平均数是 {avg}，它们的和是多少？

solution.en: Sum = number of terms × average = {n} × {avg} = {sum}. (The fact they are even and consecutive only guarantees the average is the middle term.)
solution.zh: 总和 = 项数 × 平均数 = {n} × {avg} = {sum}。（是「连续偶数」只是保证平均数正好是中间那个数。）

templates.title: 把百分数化成最简分数

stem.en: Which of the following fractions is the equivalent of {p}%?
stem.zh: 下面哪个分数等于 {p}%？

solution.en: {p}% means {p} parts out of 100, which is the same as [[{k}/{base}]]. In its simplest form, divide the top and bottom by their highest common factor: [[{k}/{base}]] = [[{n}/{d}]].
solution.zh: {p}% 就是 100 份里取 {p} 份，即 [[{k}/{base}]]。把它化成最简分数，分子分母同除以最大公因数，得 [[{n}/{d}]]。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 按比例分配总量求差

stem.en: The weights of two ships are in the ratio of {m} : {n}. If together they weigh {T} tonnes, how many more tonnes does the larger ship weigh?
stem.zh: 两艘船的重量比是 {m} : {n}，两艘船共重 {T} 吨。较大的那艘船比小的一艘重多少吨？

solution.en: Total parts = {m} + {n} = {m+n}. One part = {T} ÷ {m+n}. The difference is ({n} − {m}) = {abs(n-m)} parts, so {abs(n-m)} × {T} ÷ {m+n} = {diff} tonnes.
solution.zh: 总份数 = {m} + {n} = {m+n}。一份 = {T} ÷ {m+n}。差 {n} − {m} = {abs(n-m)} 份，所以相差 {abs(n-m)} × {T} ÷ {m+n} = {diff} 吨。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 人数固定，组越小组数越多

stem.en: A class of {N} students is to be divided into smaller groups. If each group is to contain 3, 4, or 5 people, what is the largest number of groups possible?
stem.zh: 一个 {N} 人的班要分成若干小组。每组只能有 3 人、4 人或 5 人，最多能分成多少个组？

solution.en: To get the MOST groups, make the groups as small as possible. Using groups of 3 gives {q} groups, using {3*q} students. The remaining {r} {r} student(s) can be absorbed by turning some groups of 3 into groups of 4 or 5 (a group of 3 + 1 → 4, a group of 3 + 2 → 5), so the number of groups stays {ans}.
solution.zh: 要组数最多，每组就尽量小。用 3 人组可以分成 {q} 组，用掉 {3*q} 人。剩下的 {r} 人可以并入已有的组（3+1 变 4 人组、3+2 变 5 人组），组数不变，所以最多 {ans} 组。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由速度求更长时间行驶的路程

stem.en: If a train travels n kilometres in {t1} hours, how many kilometres will it travel in {t2} hours?
stem.zh: 一列火车 {t1} 小时行驶 n 千米，那么 {t2} 小时能行驶多少千米？

solution.en: In {t1} hours it covers n km, so in 1 hour it covers n ÷ {t1} km. In {t2} hours it covers {t2} ÷ {t1} = {mult} times as far, that is {mult} × n km.
solution.zh: {t1} 小时行驶 n 千米，所以每小时行 n ÷ {t1} 千米。{t2} 小时是 {t1} 小时的 {mult} 倍，因此共行 {mult} × n 千米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 减速后时间变长，求原速度

stem.en: Steven travels from Shanghai to Beijing by car in {t1} hours. If he reduces the speed of his car by {d} km/h, then he takes {t2} hours for the same distance. Find the distance between the two towns, in kilometres.
stem.zh: Steven 开车从上海到北京用了 {t1} 小时。如果他把车速每小时降低 {d} 千米，那么同样的路程要用 {t2} 小时。求两城之间的距离（千米）。

solution.en: Let the original speed be v. The distance is the same both times, so {t1}v = {t2}(v − {d}). Expanding: {t1}v = {t2}v − {t2*d}. Hence ({t2} − {t1})v = {t2*d}, so v = {v} km/h. Distance = {t1} × {v} = {dist} km.
solution.zh: 设原速为 v。两次路程相同，所以 {t1}v = {t2}(v − {d})，展开得 {t1}v = {t2}v − {t2*d}，即 ({t2} − {t1})v = {t2*d}，解得 v = {v} 千米/时。距离 = {t1} × {v} = {dist} 千米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 面积固定时判断哪组底高不可能

stem.en: Look at the triangle. The area of the triangle is {A} cm². Which pair of base and height is NOT possible?
stem.zh: 看下图。这个三角形的面积是 {A} 平方厘米。下面哪一对「底 × 高」是不可能的？

options.zh: 底 {b0} 厘米，高 {h0} 厘米
底 {b1} 厘米，高 {h1} 厘米
底 {b2} 厘米，高 {h2} 厘米
底 {b3} 厘米，高 {h3} 厘米

solution.en: Area = ½ × base × height = {A}, so base × height must equal {2*A}. The first three options multiply to {2*A}: {b0}×{h0} = {b0*h0}, {b1}×{h1} = {b1*h1}, {b2}×{h2} = {b2*h2}. But {b3} × {h3} = {b3h3} ≠ {2*A}. Answer D.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 平行四边形被分成两部分，判断哪个结论一定成立

stem.en: A parallelogram is divided into two parts, P1 and P2, by the line shown in the picture. Which of the following statements is SURELY true?
stem.zh: 如下图，一个平行四边形被图中这条线分成 P1 和 P2 两部分。下面哪个说法一定成立？

options.en: P2 has a greater perimeter than P1
options.zh: P2 的周长比 P1 大

options.en: P1 and P2 have the same perimeter
options.zh: P1 和 P2 的周长相等

options.en: P2 has a smaller perimeter than P1
options.zh: P2 的周长比 P1 小

options.en: P2 has a smaller area than P1
options.zh: P2 的面积比 P1 小

solution.en: Both parts share the whole edge of the zig-zag cut, and both are bounded by the same top and bottom sides of the parallelogram. Adding up the four sides, P1 and P2 use exactly the same total length of boundary — so their perimeters are equal. (Their areas are equal too, but the question asks about perimeter.)
solution.zh: 两块都沿着同一条锯齿形切边，又各自由平行四边形同样的上边和下边围成。把四条边加起来，P1 和 P2 用到的边界长度完全一样，所以周长相等。（面积也确实相等，但本题问的是周长。）

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 长宽各增加后新的面积

stem.en: Michelle wants to expand her flowerbed by increasing the length and width each by {d} metres. What will the new area of the flowerbed be, if L and W represent the original length and width?
stem.zh: Michelle 想把花圃的长和宽各增加 {d} 米。如果原来的长是 L、宽是 W，新的面积是多少？

solution.en: The new length is L + {d} and the new width is W + {d}. New area = (L + {d})(W + {d}) = L×W + {d}L + {d}W + {d}×{d} = LW + {d}L + {d}W + {d2}.
solution.zh: 新的长是 L + {d}，新的宽是 W + {d}。新面积 = (L + {d})(W + {d}) = L×W + {d}L + {d}W + {d}×{d} = LW + {d}L + {d}W + {d2}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 十二生肖循环求年份的生肖

stem.en: The Chinese Calendar is based on a twelve-year cycle. Each year in the cycle corresponds to an animal: tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, sheep (or goat), monkey, rooster, dog, pig, rat and ox. The order of the animals never changes. The year {y0} in the Chinese Calendar is the Year of the {a0} (number {i0} in the cycle). Which animal will mark the year {y1}?
stem.zh: 中国农历以十二年为一轮，依次为：虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪、鼠、牛，顺序永不改变。已知 {y0} 年是{a0}年（第 {i0} 位），那么 {y1} 年是什么年？

solution.en: From {y0} to {y1} is {y1-y0} years, and {y1-y0} ÷ 12 leaves remainder {mod(y1-y0,12)}. Moving {mod(y1-y0,12)} places on from position {i0} lands on position {idx}, the year of the {ans}.
solution.zh: {y0} 到 {y1} 相隔 {y1-y0} 年，{y1-y0} ÷ 12 余 {mod(y1-y0,12)}。从第 {i0} 位再往后数 {mod(y1-y0,12)} 位，落在第 {idx} 位，即{ans}年。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 判断哪句关于数的说法正确

stem.en: Which of the following is a true statement?
stem.zh: 下面哪句话是正确的？

options.en: The product of two negative numbers is negative.
options.zh: 两个负数相乘，积是负数。

options.en: The product of one negative and one positive number is positive.
options.zh: 一个负数乘一个正数，积是正数。

options.en: When dividing a positive number by a negative number, the result is negative.
options.zh: 正数除以负数，商是负数。

options.en: When dividing a negative number by a positive number, the result is positive.
options.zh: 负数除以正数，商是正数。

solution.en: Check each one: (A) negative × negative is POSITIVE, so false. (B) negative × positive is NEGATIVE, so false. (C) positive ÷ negative is negative — TRUE. (D) negative ÷ positive is negative, not positive, so false.
solution.zh: 逐条验证：(A) 负×负 = 正，错。(B) 负×正 = 负，错。(C) 正÷负 = 负，正确。(D) 负÷正 = 负（不是正），错。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 求「负场 : 总场数」并化简

stem.en: A men's basketball team won {w} games and lost {l} games. What is the ratio of games lost to the number of games played, in simplest form?
stem.zh: 一支男子篮球队赢了 {w} 场、输了 {l} 场。负场数与总场数的最简整数比是多少？

solution.en: Number of games played = {w} + {l} = {tot}. Ratio lost : played = {l} : {tot}, and dividing both numbers by their highest common factor {kL} gives {cs}:{ct}.
solution.zh: 总场数 = {w} + {l} = {tot}（场）。负场 : 总场数 = {l} : {tot}，两边同除以最大公因数 {kL}，化简得 {cs}:{ct}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 赛季进行一半时推算最终胜场差

stem.en: In a baseball league each team plays {G} games. After playing half of their games, team A has won {a} games and team B has won {b} games. If team B wins all of its remaining games and team A loses all of its remaining games, how many more games has team B won than team A at the end of the season?
stem.zh: 某棒球联盟每队要打 {G} 场。赛程过半时，A 队胜了 {a} 场、B 队胜了 {b} 场。如果后半程 B 队全胜、A 队全负，赛季结束时 B 队比 A 队多胜多少场？

solution.en: There are {G}/2 = {G/2} games left. Team A finishes with {a} wins; team B finishes with {b} + {G/2} = {b+G/2} wins. The difference is {b+G/2} − {a} = {diff}.
solution.zh: 还剩 {G}/2 = {G/2} 场。A 队最终 {a} 胜；B 队最终 {b} + {G/2} = {b+G/2} 胜。相差 {b+G/2} − {a} = {diff} 场。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 等腰三角形周长等于等边三角形周长，求边长

stem.en: An isosceles triangle has two sides of {p} cm and {q} cm. An equilateral triangle has the same perimeter. What is the length, in centimetres, of each side of the equilateral triangle?
stem.zh: 一个等腰三角形的边长分别是 {p} 厘米和 {q} 厘米（等边的两边相等）。另一个等边三角形的周长与它相同，这个等边三角形的边长是多少厘米？

solution.en: The equal sides are the shorter ones, so the perimeter is {p} + {p} + {q} = {per} cm. The equilateral triangle's side is {per} ÷ 3 = {side} cm.
solution.zh: 等腰两边是较短的那组，所以周长 = {p} + {p} + {q} = {per} 厘米。等边三角形边长 = {per} ÷ 3 = {side} 厘米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 按百分比分类计数求差

stem.en: On a farm {S} sheep gave birth. {p}% of the sheep gave birth to two lambs each. The rest of the sheep gave birth to just one lamb each. How many sheep are there altogether?
stem.zh: 农场里有 {S} 只母羊生产。其中 {p}% 的母羊各生了 2 只小羊，其余的母羊各生了 1 只小羊。农场一共养了多少只羊？

solution.en: The {S} mothers themselves are {S} sheep. The extra lambs are the second ones: {p}% of {S} = {twoG} sheep had a second lamb. So the total is {S} + {twoG} = {total}.
solution.zh: {S} 只母羊本身就有 {S} 只；额外多出来的只是「第二只小羊」：{S} 的 {p}% = {twoG} 只母羊多生了 1 只。所以一共 {S} + {twoG} = {total} 只。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 买几送一，求最多能买几个

stem.en: A team has ${M}.00 to buy balls. One ball costs ${c}. The team is given 1 free ball for every {k} balls it buys. What is the largest number of balls the team can get?
stem.zh: 一支队伍有 {M} 元买球，每个球 {c} 元。每买 {k-1} 个球就赠送 1 个球。他们最多能拿到多少个球？

solution.en: "1 free for every {k} bought" means every batch of {k} costs only {k}−1 paid balls. With ${M} at ${c} each the team can pay for {paid} balls. Each {k-1} paid balls earns 1 free one: {paid} ÷ {k-1} = {free} free balls. Total = {paid} + {free} = {total} balls.
solution.zh: “每买 {k-1} 个送 1 个”意味着每 {k} 个球只付 {k}−1 个的钱。{M} 元每个 {c} 元，能付 {paid} 个。每 {k-1} 个付钱的球得 1 个赠球：{paid} ÷ {k-1} = {free} 个。共 {paid} + {free} = {total} 个球。

templates.title: 正方形四角各去掉一个小正方形后的面积

stem.en: The following is a {S} cm square. Four {c} cm squares are removed from each of the four corners. What is the area of the remaining shaded part of the figure, in cm²?
stem.zh: 下图是一个边长 {S} 厘米的正方形，从四个角各剪去一个边长 {c} 厘米的小正方形。剩下部分（阴影）的面积是多少平方厘米？

solution.en: The whole square is {S} × {S} = {S*S} cm². Four corners of {c} × {c} = {c*c} cm² are removed, that is 4 × {c*c} = {4*c*c} cm². Shaded area = {S*S} − {4*c*c} = {area} cm².
solution.zh: 整个正方形 {S} × {S} = {S*S} 平方厘米。四个角各去掉 {c} × {c} = {c*c} 平方厘米，共 4 × {c*c} = {4*c*c} 平方厘米。阴影面积 = {S*S} − {4*c*c} = {area} 平方厘米。

stem.en: Jane and Kate are ski racing. They both start at the same place, at the same time, and follow the same path. Jane is travelling at {v1} m/s and Kate is travelling at {v2} m/s. How many metres ahead is Kate after {t} seconds?

solution.en: Kate gains on Jane at {v2} − {v1} = {v2-v1} m every second. After {t} seconds she is {v2-v1} × {t} = {gap} metres ahead.
solution.zh: Kate 每秒比 Jane 多走 {v2} − {v1} = {v2-v1} 米。{t} 秒后领先 {v2-v1} × {t} = {gap} 米。

stem.en: The number line below runs from 0 to {E}. Which lettered point best represents the value of {cName} divided by {fName}?
stem.zh: 下面的数轴从 0 标到 {E}，A 到 H 是 8 个等分点。哪个字母表示的点最接近「{cName} 除以 {fName}」的值？

solution.en: From 0 to {E}, the eight points A–H are each {E} ÷ 8 = {E/8} apart. {cName} is at {E} × {ci} ÷ 8 = {E*ci/8} and {fName} is at {E} × {fj} ÷ 8 = {E*fj/8}. So {cName} ÷ {fName} = {E*ci/8} ÷ {E*fj/8} = {q}. That value sits at the {ci/fj*8}th point from 0, which is {kName}.
solution.zh: 0 到 {E} 之间的 A–H 八个点，每格是 {E} ÷ 8 = {E/8}。{cName} 在 {E} × {ci} ÷ 8 = {E*ci/8} 处，{fName} 在 {E} × {fj} ÷ 8 = {E*fj/8} 处。所以 {cName} ÷ {fName} = {E*ci/8} ÷ {E*fj/8} = {q}，正好落在从 0 数第 {ci/fj*8} 个点上，即 {kName}。

stem.en: At a stationery shop, a pack of {a} notebooks costs ${c1} and a pack of {b} notebooks costs ${c2}. What is the least amount of money needed to buy {T} notebooks?
stem.zh: 文具店里 {a} 本一包的本子卖 {c1} 元，{b} 本一包的本子卖 {c2} 元。要买 {T} 本，最少花多少钱？

solution.en: Compare price per notebook: ${c1} ÷ {a} vs ${c2} ÷ {b}. The {b}-pack is better value. To get exactly {T} notebooks: {x} packs of {a} plus {y} packs of {b} gives {a}×{x} + {b}×{y} = {T}. Cost = {x}×${c1} + {y}×${c2} = ${best}.

templates.title: 每名队员上场时间相同，求每人上场分钟数

stem.en: There are {N} men on a basketball team, and in a game {k} of them play at any one time. If the game is {T} minutes long and each man plays exactly the same number of minutes, how many minutes does each man play?
stem.zh: 一支篮球队有 {N} 名队员，场上同时有 {k} 人。一场比赛 {T} 分钟，如果每人上场时间完全相同，每人上场多少分钟？

solution.en: Every minute {k} men are on court, so total player-minutes = {k} × {T} = {tot}. Shared equally among {N} men: {tot} ÷ {N} = {each} minutes each.
solution.zh: 每分钟场上有 {k} 人，所以总上场人次 = {k} × {T} = {tot}。平分给 {N} 人：{tot} ÷ {N} = {each} 分钟。

solution.en: Whoever walks the longest route finishes last. The red route goes straight across and straight up: {m} + {n} = {m+n} blocks — the shortest. Blue, green and orange each add extra detours (2, 4 and 6 blocks more), so orange is the longest. Orange is {ans}.

stem.en: A right-angled isosceles triangle must have

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 一面靠墙围花园，求篱笆长度与面积

stem.en: Gary has {F} metres of fence to enclose his garden. One side of the garden does not need to be fenced. The width of the garden is {k}/{m} of the length. How long is the garden, in metres?
stem.zh: Gary 有 {F} 米篱笆要围住花园，花园的一边不需要围。花园的宽是长的 {k}/{m}。花园的长是多少米？

solution.en: Only three sides are fenced: two widths and one length. Width = {k}/{m} of the length, so 长度 + 2 × ({k}/{m} × 长) = {F}. That is 长 × (1 + {2*k}/{m}) = {F}, so 长 × {m+2*k}/{m} = {F} and 长 = {F} × {m} ÷ {m+2*k} = {L} metres.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两个全等三角形拼成菱形，求边长

stem.en: The triangles ABD and BCD have the same area. The length of AB is one {k}th of the length of BD. If the total area of the two triangles is {total} cm², find the length of AB, in centimetres.
stem.zh: 三角形 ABD 与 BCD 面积相同。AB 的长度是 BD 的 {k} 分之一。两个三角形的面积之和是 {total} 平方厘米，求 AB 的长度（厘米）。

solution.en: Each triangle is right-angled with legs AB and BD, and they have equal areas, so each is half the total. Let AB = x, then BD = {k}x. One triangle = ½ × x × {k}x = {k}x²/2, so the two together = {k}x². Given {k}x² = {total}, x² = {x*x}, so x = {x}. AB = {x} cm.
solution.zh: 两个三角形都是直角边为 AB、BD 的直角三角形，且面积相同，所以各占总面积的一半。设 AB = x，则 BD = {k}x。一个三角形面积 = ½ × x × {k}x = {k}x²/2，两个合计 = {k}x²。由 {k}x² = {total} 得 x² = {x*x}，所以 x = {x}。AB = {x} 厘米。
